observations.body: Jesus recalls neighbor love and the saying to hate an enemy, then commands love, blessing, good, and prayer toward enemies and persecutors.
observations.label: Enemy love is grounded in the Father’s generosity: action

observations.body: The Father gives sun and rain to evil and good, and the hearers are called beyond reciprocal love toward perfection.
observations.label: Enemy love is grounded in the Father’s generosity: response

observations.body: love enemies · pray · Father · sun and rain · perfect

payload.posture: Read Matthew 5:43–48 as law, righteousness, and the inner life evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: “Hate your enemy” is not quoted from one supplied command, and “perfect” requires lexical and contextual care.
